details.method: After verifying actual worker start, observe asynchronous resource cleanup until a finite deadline that covers the implementation retry budget; keep the required final absence assertion. Reproduce short-deadline failures with a controlled OS file lock before changing a fixture.
details.when: Windows forced process cancellation is followed by an independent cleanup process with explicitly bounded busy-file retries.
details.counterexample: Longer waiting cannot establish correct process ownership or repair a leaked cleanup worker; persistent files after the supported retry budget still fail. A controlled lock does not identify the actual external actor on hosted CI.
details.trial_plan: On future adoption hold a real attachment handle beyond the old fixture deadline then release it; require eventual removal within the supported budget. Also keep the handle past that budget and require failure, without relaxing production retries or the deletion assertion.
